##### Project general facts

Discover Avena at The Valley, where contemporary elegance meets the gentle embrace of nature. This enchanting community of 4-bedroom villas is thoughtfully designed to offer a lifestyle of harmony and sustainability. 4-bedroom villas in three façade styles, designed to offer a sustainable lifestyle in harmony with the environment. 

Living at Avena means finding balance and forging connections. Stroll through lush landscapes, embark on outdoor adventures, and create lasting bonds with your neighbours. Here, every day offers a blend of relaxation and excitement. Villas, each boasting four bedrooms, are designed with families in mind. Spacious and luxurious, these homes provide the perfect combination of comfort and practicality for modern living.cess to upcoming amenities catered towards an active lifestyle.

Elegant 4-bedroom villas designed for sustainable living. A perfect blend of modernity and nature, offering contemporary elegance. Harmonious and sustainable lifestyle amidst nature. Modern finishing with high-quality materials. Three unique façade styles with modern elegance. Warm, stylish interiors with natural tones.

##### Location description and benefits

The Valley is a quaint new town consisting of modern complexes where life finds its inspiration amidst the vast shimmering sands and lush green open spaces. Discover new facets of The Valley, where beautifully landscaped urban gardens invite you to immerse yourself in nature and live the active lifestyle you’ve always dreamed of. This brings together serene dunes, lush forest walks, and open meadows that call you to relax, play, and explore.

Nestled across a sprawling 200 hectares, The Valley isn’t just a location; it’s a phenomenon. Encompassing over 4,500 homes, it weaves a narrative of unity and nature. Every corner here tells a story, every pathway a journey. At The Valley, green tributaries do more than just pleasing the eye; they connect lives, fostering a robust community heartbeat.

This lush area is not merely a stretch of greenery; it’s equipped with exciting facilities including a trampoline park, a community garden fostering growth, and versatile sports courts. Catering to diverse interests and with the splendid Golden Beach just a step away, there’s an activity for everyone right at your doorstep.
